title: Stay Connected with FreeTV Garden
body:
Stay up to date with the latest FreeTV Garden announcements, new features, important notices, and service updates.

**Join our Telegram Channel**
Get the latest updates, new features, availability information, and important announcements directly on Telegram:
https://t.me/Freetools_channel

**Join the Telegram Discussion Group**
Connect and interact with other FreeTV Garden users, share your experience, discuss available channels, and help us improve the service:
https://t.me/aFreetools

**Report Issues & Share Suggestions**
Found a problem, unavailable channel, incorrect information, or have an idea for a new feature? You can contact us directly at:
contact.freetool@gmail.com

You can also visit https://freetvgarden.com for the latest information and updates.

Your feedback helps us improve FreeTV Garden and provide a better experience for everyone.
